name: application-feature-comparison-matrix
title: Feature Comparison Matrix
description: Sticky-header table comparing plans or products across feature rows with check/dash/limit cells, driven by a typed plans/rows prop contract.
useWhen: Comparing multiple plans, tiers, or product SKUs across a shared list of features or limits.
Some cells are boolean (included/not included) while others carry a specific limit or value.
One plan should be visually emphasized as the recommended or most popular option.
avoidWhen: You only need marketing-style pricing cards without a shared feature list — use the pricing table component instead.
The comparison has only two options — a simple two-column layout may communicate the difference faster than a full matrix.
Feature rows number in the hundreds — pair this with search/filtering rather than a single static table.
responsiveBehavior: The feature-label column stays pinned via position:sticky while the plan columns scroll horizontally on narrow viewports, keeping row context visible during comparison.
accessibility: Boolean cells pair an icon with visually hidden 'Included'/'Not included' text, so screen readers don't rely on the icon alone.
The highlighted/recommended plan column uses a filled background in addition to its badge label, not color alone.
Column headers use scope='col' so assistive technology can associate each cell with its plan when navigating the table.

variants.title: Feature Comparison Matrix
variants.description: Three-plan comparison table with a sticky feature column, a highlighted 'Popular' plan, boolean check/dash cells, and value cells for limits.
accessibility: Boolean feature cells always carry visually hidden text alongside the check/dash icon.

variants.title: Feature Comparison Matrix (Dark)
variants.description: Plan comparison table adapted for dark surfaces with the same sticky column, highlighted plan, and cell structure.
accessibility: Header, row, and highlighted-column text must meet WCAG AA contrast on dark surfaces.
